args.title: Bellwether Office: Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
• Bellwether Office’s latest newsletter highlights its “Cold-chain logistics in 2026” article and directs readers to the related analysis and companion piece.
• The article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data; most savings resulted from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
• The companion piece says pilot programs reduced claims by 25%.
